title: Addresses in a nested encoding
statement: For bit strings $a,b,c$, the nested encoding $\langle a,\langle b,c\rangle\rangle$ has the following entries: at position $2i$ it equals the $i$th bit of $a$ whenever $i<|a|$; at position $2|a|+2+2i$ it equals the $i$th bit of $b$ whenever $i<|b|$; and at position $2|a|+2+2|b|+2+i$ it equals the $i$th bit of $c$ for every natural number $i$, with out-of-range list entries interpreted as false.
